query.description: Chain 포함 도형 저장 (InsertExecuteMultiple, Marker는 INPUT / OUTPUT만)
query.commandtext: INSERT INTO TQP_GDS_CHAIN_MEMBER (FACTORY, DEVICE_ID, CHAIN_SEQ, VERSION_NO, PLACED_ELEMENT_ID, ROLE_CODE, INCLUSION_SOURCE, MARKER_X, MARKER_Y) VALUES (:factory, :device_id, :chain_seq, 1, :placed_element_id, :role_code, :inclusion_source, TO_BINARY_DOUBLE(:marker_x), TO_BINARY_DOUBLE(:marker_y))

query.description: Chain 포함 도형 조회 + 도형 Layer (2026-10-06 3단계: View 화면이 Chain에 필요한 Layer를 함께 조회하기 위해 LAYER_ID 추가)
query.commandtext: SELECT /*+ LEADING(M) USE_NL(P) INDEX(P PK_GDS_PLACED_EL) */ M.PLACED_ELEMENT_ID, M.ROLE_CODE, M.INCLUSION_SOURCE, M.MARKER_X, M.MARKER_Y, P.LAYER_ID, P.DATA_TYPE FROM TQP_GDS_CHAIN_MEMBER M JOIN TQP_GDS_PLACED_EL P ON P.FACTORY = M.FACTORY AND P.DEVICE_ID = M.DEVICE_ID AND P.PLACED_ELEMENT_ID = M.PLACED_ELEMENT_ID WHERE M.FACTORY = :factory AND M.DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND M.CHAIN_SEQ = :chain_seq AND M.VERSION_NO = 1 ORDER BY M.PLACED_ELEMENT_ID

query.description: 연관 분석: Device 전체 Chain Member + 도형 Layer / Bounds
query.commandtext: SELECT /*+ LEADING(M) USE_NL(P) INDEX(P PK_GDS_PLACED_EL) */ M.CHAIN_SEQ, M.PLACED_ELEMENT_ID, M.ROLE_CODE, P.LAYER_ID, P.DATA_TYPE, P.MIN_X, P.MIN_Y, P.MAX_X, P.MAX_Y FROM TQP_GDS_CHAIN_MEMBER M JOIN TQP_GDS_PLACED_EL P ON P.FACTORY = M.FACTORY AND P.DEVICE_ID = M.DEVICE_ID AND P.PLACED_ELEMENT_ID = M.PLACED_ELEMENT_ID WHERE M.FACTORY = :factory AND M.DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND M.VERSION_NO = 1 ORDER BY M.CHAIN_SEQ, M.PLACED_ELEMENT_ID

query.description: 연관 분석: Device 전체 Chain Member + 도형 모양(종류 / 폭 / 끝 처리 / 좌표)
query.commandtext: SELECT /*+ LEADING(M) USE_NL(P) INDEX(P PK_GDS_PLACED_EL) */ M.CHAIN_SEQ, M.PLACED_ELEMENT_ID, M.ROLE_CODE, P.LAYER_ID, P.DATA_TYPE, P.ELEMENT_TYPE, P.CLOSED_FLAG, P.PATH_WIDTH, P.PATH_TYPE, P.MIN_X, P.MIN_Y, P.MAX_X, P.MAX_Y, P.POINTS_FORMAT_VERSION, P.POINT_COUNT, P.POINTS_BIN FROM TQP_GDS_CHAIN_MEMBER M JOIN TQP_GDS_PLACED_EL P ON P.FACTORY = M.FACTORY AND P.DEVICE_ID = M.DEVICE_ID AND P.PLACED_ELEMENT_ID = M.PLACED_ELEMENT_ID WHERE M.FACTORY = :factory AND M.DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND M.VERSION_NO = 1 ORDER BY M.CHAIN_SEQ, M.PLACED_ELEMENT_ID

query.description: 저장 확정 검사: Member 수 / INPUT 수 / OUTPUT 수
query.commandtext: SELECT COUNT(*) AS MEMBER_COUNT, NVL(SUM(CASE ROLE_CODE WHEN 'INPUT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS INPUT_COUNT, NVL(SUM(CASE ROLE_CODE WHEN 'OUTPUT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS OUTPUT_COUNT FROM TQP_GDS_CHAIN_MEMBER WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND CHAIN_SEQ = :chain_seq AND VERSION_NO = 1

query.description: Map 복사: Chain 포함 도형 / 단자 Marker
query.commandtext: INSERT INTO TQP_GDS_CHAIN_MEMBER (FACTORY, DEVICE_ID, CHAIN_SEQ, VERSION_NO, PLACED_ELEMENT_ID, ROLE_CODE, INCLUSION_SOURCE, MARKER_X, MARKER_Y) SELECT FACTORY, :target_device_id, :new_chain_seq, VERSION_NO, PLACED_ELEMENT_ID, ROLE_CODE, INCLUSION_SOURCE, MARKER_X, MARKER_Y FROM TQP_GDS_CHAIN_MEMBER WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :source_device_id AND CHAIN_SEQ = :source_chain_seq
